knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

```
library(tidyverse)
# remotes::install_github("einarhjorleifsson/orit")
library(orit)
con <- hr_connection(read_rds("/home/haf/einarhj/stasi/hafriti/TOPSECRET.rds"))
hr_sensor(con, skip = "arni") |> 
  mutate(year = year(date_time),
         month = month(date_time)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(json_message),
         year == 2024,
         month == 3) |> 
  collect() ->
  d
# just the first record: 
d |> 
  slice(1) |> 
  pull(json_message) ->
  txt
# one way, but requires writing to disk
cat(txt, file = "tmp.json")
jsonlite::fromJSON("tmp.json")
```
